inputs.question: Are there any retaining walls greater than 2 feet in height shown on this grading plan? If yes, do they show both top and bottom elevations?
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether elevation annotations (top and bottom) are labelled on retaining wall features shown in the drawing. This is a drawing-element annotation check, not a measurement of distance/clearance between features. The presence check (are there walls >2 ft?) is preliminary, but the core question targets whether elevation labels appear on the drawing itself.
